defaults.summary: show a command's option defaults: built-in in white, customized in blue

demo-fn1.summary: demo shell command: prints its name, then whoami@hostname

demo-fn2.summary: demo shell command: prints its name, then the OS and the date

pycache.summary: clean the uv and pip caches, by package prefix (default tabsdata) or all of it

tdd-env.summary: activate --toolset <toolset>, or deactivate, a toolset venv in this shell

vars.summary: unset groups of environment variables in this shell: --dev (TD_*), --pypi (UV/PIP index)

venv.summary: create, activate, deactivate, delete or list managed venvs (pyenv, uv or conda)

demo-exe1.summary: demo tool in the demo-env1 toolset: prints its name

demo-exe2.summary: demo tool in the demo-env2 toolset: prints its name
